item.title: Solved: How to Type Hint a Lambda Function in Python
item.description:
Is it possible to apply type hints to lambda functions in Python? This question frequently arises among developers as lambda function syntax can often be perplexing when trying to introduce type annotations. Fortunately, there are several approaches we can employ for effective type hinting in lambdas.

Method 1: Using the Callable Type
